name: @aily-project/lib-cycore-nes
author: Cycore; Nofrendo contributors
description: 面向Wifiduino 32S3的NES模拟器，支持把.nes预置进APP并自动复制到FFat，也支持WiFi网页上传ROM。
description_zh_cn: 面向Wifiduino 32S3的NES模拟器，支持把.nes预置进APP并自动复制到FFat，也支持WiFi网页上传ROM。
description_en: NES emulator for Wifiduino 32S3 with compile-time embedded ROM installation and WiFi web upload to FFat.

bundledSources.name: Nofrendo
bundledSources.author: Matthew Conte and contributors
bundledSources.reason: Bundles the emulator core and Cycore-specific FFat, ST7789, controller, save-state, and audio adapters.

platformPrerequisites: Wifiduino 32S3 with 16 MB Flash and PSRAM
Default app3M_fat9M_16MB partition scheme (3 MB APP + 9.9 MB FATFS)
ST7789 SPI display and six active-low buttons
